narration_timeline.text: A pale horse drinks beside the shoreline, lowering its muzzle toward the water.
narration_timeline.scene: Clear pale horse actually drinking from a water edge in source_01, not grazing

narration_timeline.text: In another recording, a tan horse grazes near the water instead of drinking.
narration_timeline.scene: Real pale/tan horse grazing on shore bank in source_00, not drinking

narration_timeline.text: Along a separate shore, a group of horses moves across the open ground and pauses.
Elsewhere, a brown horse grazes in an open field, while another horse stands close to a person.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic grazing horse in one source; another horse next to an actual person in separately filmed scene

narration_timeline.text: Two spring recordings show other horses near open water, shifting across grassy shores at their own pace.
narration_timeline.scene: Real herds and grazing horses filmed on separate wetland shores

narration_timeline.text: A white horse finishes our journey, feeding quietly among trees at the meadow's edge.
narration_timeline.scene: White horse grazing by woodland trees
